geometry: Existing scripts/biome_extension_structures.gd prism emitter is reused through twelve bounded numeric prototypes. Optional true spanning forms reuse existing four elongated flat-cap prototypes and independently measure/bury complete contact rings at BOTH real rock surfaces;no new prototype,SceneNode per crystal or separate cave volume. optics: Reuses shaders/crystal_bulk_optics.gdshaderinc:authored Beer-Lambert/Fresnel/IOR approximation,not measured spectral mineral data or ray tracing. Most geometry is opaque. Thin-section eligibility is followed by an independent stable25percent population selection;small fluorite primaries additionally require their own25percent eligibility channel. Selected near pieces use scene-color transmission/refraction approximation and a separate opaque native far proxy;large blocks remain opaque. Thickness uses the actual habit cross-section. Ordinary minerals have no intrinsic emission. Explicitly fictional rare mineral regions use stable.005region/.12form selection,hard10percent cell cap and faint.025cyan/blue/violet emission on selected existing opaque prisms only. Lossless thickness-UV sign encoding leaves all geometry/collision/LOD intact. No dynamic crystal light nodes,extra textures or particles.
surface_detail: Authored procedural growth zoning,sub-metre cloudy inclusions,filtered cleavage striae/grain,finite mineral beds and independently controlled rough floor sediment,not photographed mineral scans. Sediment is slope- and dry-surface-masked,uses filtered physical grain coordinates and changes only shading. Small fractured mineral clasts reuse the four elongated prototypes with actual whole-foot floor fitting;at most16clasts inside the original160form budget,generated AFTER all major forms,without extra colliders/transmission. Growth zoning and striae use physical crystal-axis UV2 coordinates with deterministic per-patch phase,so tilted/ceiling minerals are not painted with world-horizontal stripes. World-space inclusion/grain coordinates remain continuous across3840m macro origins. Hard facet normals remain unchanged. Host mineral veins preserve existing PBR rock rather than replacing all walls with a single gray or purple material.
limitations: Current native renders verify actual geometry/material/LOD mechanisms,not final photographic or reference-quality crystal art. Full live traversal,all requested large-region scenic targets,transition breadth,performance and final registration remain in progress.
